rows.title: NBTE is established
rows.body: Act No. 9 of 11 January 1977 creates the National Board for Technical Education, headquartered on Bida Road, Kaduna.

rows.title: Power to set standards
rows.body: The Act is amended and minimum standards for all technical and vocational programmes come under NBTE.

rows.title: Private polytechnics
rows.body: Private providers may establish polytechnics and monotechnics under NBTE approval.

rows.title: National Skills Qualifications
rows.body: The National Skills Qualifications Framework brings sector skills councils, awarding bodies and NSQ centres under one system.

rows.title: Digital quality assurance
rows.body: Digital quality assurance (DQA) and TEQA bring accreditation online: self-study questionnaires, hybrid visits and 16 portals.

rows.title: Digital NBTE
rows.body: One workspace for staff and one portal for institutions, from registration to decision.
